title: Mistral Acquires Design Agency New Material to Build Sovereign Frontier AI
summary:
The Paris-based AI firm is establishing a new division called 'Solutions Design' to integrate customer feedback more tightly into its engineering process. Mistral acquired the design agency New Material to bridge the gap between product and engineering, creating a feedback loop where the team co-develops tools directly with users to refine real-world deployments.

New Material specializes in building AI-native products, workflows, and ventures, often forward-deploying design for organizations restructuring their operations. By absorbing the agency, Mistral aims to advance its development of sovereign frontier AI, as announced by the agency's founders and amplified by Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch.
